cases.label: citation_present
cases.guards_against: The source preview stops drawing a box for a cited field, or a "View source region" link no longer lands on its box (click-to-source broken on a vector lab PDF).

cases.label: citation_present
cases.guards_against: Click-to-source breaks on a rasterized intake PDF: a cited field has no box on the page image, or a link targets a missing box.

cases.label: factually_consistent
cases.guards_against: The local-lexical retriever stops expanding a lab abbreviation into its condition, so a fatigue intake with the question "what does the low hgb suggest" ranks an unrelated kidney-test chunk first instead of an anemia chunk.

cases.label: factually_consistent
cases.guards_against: When the Gemini embed call fails and the deployed hybrid retriever falls back to BM25, a lab report with a low hemoglobin and a high A1C gets three A1C chunks and no anemia guideline, because the hemoglobin finding is no longer expanded to its condition.

cases.label: citation_present
cases.guards_against: A guideline claim with an appended sentence that no quote supports ("The guideline recommends this for the patient.") passes the structural verifier; the critic must veto it as UNCITED, and the veto must be applied and traced.

cases.label: safe_refusal
cases.guards_against: A medication directive in the verifier's own vocabulary ("The patient has to be taking lisinopril ...") passes the structural verifier; the critic must veto it as UNSAFE_ACTION before it reaches the clinician.

cases.label: factually_consistent
cases.guards_against: A critic that keeps every claim still changes the answer (drops, reorders or rewrites a claim), or the answer is labeled something other than reviewed.

cases.label: factually_consistent
cases.guards_against: A critic reply that adds a claim id it was never sent, or carries rewritten text, changes the shipped answer; the critic may only veto.

cases.label: factually_consistent
cases.guards_against: After the critic vetoes every claim citing a fact, the deterministic top-up or fallback puts a claim citing that same fact back (a veto turned into a rewrite), or critic_rejected and the trace count differ from what was actually removed.

cases.label: schema_valid
cases.guards_against: When the scan deadline leaves less time than the critic timeout, the critic is still called or the answer is labeled reviewed, instead of shipping as verified with critic_status skipped_budget and a degraded runtime evaluation.

cases.label: schema_valid
cases.guards_against: A critic reply that is not valid JSON is treated as a review (or crashes the request) instead of critic_status failed with the answer unchanged.

cases.label: schema_valid
cases.guards_against: With no critic model configured the answer is unlabeled or labeled reviewed, instead of critic_status disabled with a DONE critic_disabled decision.

cases.label: no_phi_in_logs
cases.guards_against: The critic request carries the patient name, date of birth, phone, patient ref or document id, or the trace or console carries claim text or any synthetic identifier.
